steps.label: Pull the week's metrics from the analytics API

code.source: const { current, previous } = data; const delta = (k) => ((current[k] - previous[k]) / previous[k] * 100).toFixed(1); return { signupsDelta: delta('signups'), activationDelta: delta('activation'), churnDelta: delta('churn'), mrrDelta: delta('mrr') };

steps.label: Write the weekly narrative
steps.prompt: Write a 3-paragraph weekly KPI report from metrics {{fetch_metrics.body.current}} and deltas {{compute_deltas}}. Lead with the most significant change, flag anything moving the wrong direction, end with one focus recommendation.
